## RGB_8BIT_SCALE variable

Factor between an 8-bit channel and its 16-bit equivalent. Because `255 × 257 = 65535`<!-- -->, the full 8-bit range maps exactly onto the full 16-bit range.

**Signature:**

```typescript
RGB_8BIT_SCALE = 257
```
